text: Janto kadi, an Nulaaɗo, tuma nde fedde goo e naafiqiiɓe ɓen wi'annoo yimɓe Madiina ɓen: "Ko onon yo yimɓe Yathrib (innde Madiina nden ado lislaamu), ñiiɓirde alanaa on "Sal’" takko Khandaq, yiltitee ka mon". Fedde goo e maɓɓe hino ɗaɓɓira Annabiijo on (yo o his) duŋayee yahugol ka mun, wiide cuuɗi maɓɓe ɗin ko huncaadɗi, kono le, wanaa ɗi huncaadɗi', wano ɓe aaƴori non. Ko ɓe faaliraa ngon nganto maɓɓe fenaande, ko dogugol ayɓe ɓen.
